title: Decide how mail to a Space inbox address counts against the Space's contact allowance, and fire contact.created

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: ensureSpaceContact (EMAIL-022) inserts contacts {space_id, source: 'space_inbox'} with no canAddSpaceContact check, and lib/crm/contact-allowance.ts, which says every Space-scoped contact write is either gated or a named exemption, lists neither. Anyone can drive it: each new sender address adds a contact to a free Space. It also never fires fireSpaceTrigger('contact.created'), which the console path does (conversations-actions.ts). Ruling: name it as a deliberate exemption (an inbound message should not be dropped), or check the allowance and record the message without a new contact. Fire the trigger either way.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/comms/space-inbox-address.ts','utf8'),a=fs.readFileSync('lib/crm/contact-allowance.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('async function ensureSpaceContact');const b=i<0?'':s.slice(i,i+2500);const gated=/canAddSpaceContact/.test(b)||/ensureSpaceContact/.test(a);const fires=/contact\\.created/.test(b);if(!gated||!fires){console.error('SCAN-1012: the Space inbox writes contacts with no allowance verdict and no contact.created trigger');process.exit(1)}"
